'''Armistice Gluuc-Brendlheim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Gluuc-Brendlheim produced the documentary ''[[Yara Grugara: Unauthorized and Totally Real]]'', an unofficial documentary about the reporter [[Yara Grugara]].
